  • fabric, beads, or metal to represent these auspicious elements.

questions.question: What kinds of embroidery are most common in Northern India, and what distinguishes them from one another? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• What kinds of embroidery are most common in Northern India, and what
  • distinguishes them from one another?
  • Chikankari, from Lucknow -delicate white -on-white embroidery on muslin -
  • featuring floral and geometric motifs. Phulkari, originating in Punjab, uses vibrant,
  • multi-colored threads to create intricate floral patterns, frequently on cotton or
  • khaddar. Kashidkari, from Jammu and Kashmir , employs a long stitch to create
  • elaborate designs, often with bright colors and intricate details. Chamba Rumal, from
  • Himachal Pradesh, is a unique form of embroidery that combines miniature painting
  • and embroidery, often on hand spun muslin with untwisted silk threads.
